games.name: After Hours
games.description: An after-dark arena tour: giant kitchens, neon rooftops, a foundry, an orbital station and a museum. Vote on maps and battle in Deathmatch, Capture the Flag or Domination.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Aquarium Forever: Beyond the Surface
games.description: Build a shared aquarium, break through the surface, raise monuments on an endless Horizon, and carry permanent bonuses into new eras.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Backgammon
games.description: Classic backgammon with hits, bar entry, doubles, forced dice usage, and bearing off.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Homegames Backstage
games.description: Build a little toy and discover how Homegames works. Eight playable experiments with inputs, cameras, multiplayer, media, live streams, saves and exports. Explore solo or bring friends.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Battleship
games.description: Place your fleet by hand, then hunt your opponent across two private ocean grids.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Billiards
games.description: 8-ball with precise physics: real cut shots, cushion mouths, ghost-ball aim guide. Play a friend or a beatable bot.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Block Brawlers
games.description: Two fully procedural polygon fighters trade body-driven punches in a tiny robot boxing ring.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Buddy Box
games.description: A panicking ragdoll buddy in a three-layer destructible world: dirt, cavern, rock, and the lava-lit deep.
games.author: AI

games.name: Checkers
games.description: American checkers with mandatory captures, multi-jumps, and kings.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Chess
games.description: Full classic chess with castling, en passant, promotion, and draw rules.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Chronoclast
games.description: A time-clone action adventure. Record your combat, build an army from your own past, and break the Paradox Engine.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Clicktionary
games.description: Take turns drawing while everyone else races to guess the word. Fast guesses score big - the artist scores when you do.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Clump
games.description: A polygonal katamari. Roll up pins, cats, cars, and the moon before the King gets bored.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Common Ground
games.description: A calm shared city builder where players independently explore one living city, place roads and zones, and watch buildings, traffic, population, and revenue grow over time.
games.author: Joseph Garcia & OpenAI

games.name: Connect Four
games.description: Drop four in a row before your opponent does.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: COPPERLINE
games.description: A West worth saving. Ride a colorful polygonal frontier, fight the Copperline railroad, build a home, and turn a battered six-shooter into a legend. A complete single-player action RPG.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Counterforge: Apex
games.description: Duel a rival that learns your habits. Defeat seven versions, then survive its unbeatable final form.
games.author: Joseph Garcia & OpenAI

games.name: Deadword
games.description: Type the word over each monster to put it down before it reaches the barricade.
games.author: AI

games.name: Defuse
games.description: Co-op bomb disposal for a voice call. One player sees the bomb - everyone else holds pieces of the manual. Talk fast.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Desert Bloom
games.description: Balance water and sunlight to grow a cactus into bloom. Drawn entirely with polygons.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Dragon Drop
games.description: Drag a little dragon, find its landing, and let go. A cozy solo physics puzzler with six expressive dragons, soft tumbles, and cascading flyaway matches.
games.author: AI

games.name: Draw
games.description: A big shared drawing board. Scroll, zoom, and doodle together.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Draw Your Own Boss
games.description: Draw a monster, give it a roar, and fight it with friends.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Engine Room
games.description: The ship is falling apart and the repair orders are on the wrong screens. Shout "SET THE QUARTERLY FLANGE TO 3" at your crew before the hull gives out. Loud, fast, and nobody's fault in particular.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Facet
games.description: Swap jewels, set off sparkling cascades, and uncover three crystal realms. Or unwind in Zen.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Fakeout
games.description: Bluffing trivia. Everyone writes a fake answer to a weird true fact, then votes for the truth. Fool your friends, find the facts.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Fleetfall
games.description: Send your fleet, then fly it through the battle. Every surviving ship counts.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Gold & Grit
games.description: Keep the bandits out of your saloon. A colorful western tower defense with 30 authored trails, branching cowboy upgrades and a portable frontier workshop.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Hangman
games.description: Pick a word, guess a letter, and save the little guy.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Happy Haulers
games.description: Choose a castle, bridge, or flower garden. Pick colorful loads, drive your smiling truck, and build your own little town.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Hot Potato
games.description: Pass the potato before it pops. Bring a friend and turn the sound up.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: House Band
games.description: Make a beat together. Add drums, a bass line, and a little echo—then keep your song.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Imposter
games.description: A phone-first party game. Everyone sees the secret word except one imposter. Talk it out, vote, and catch the faker before they blend in.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Kaboom Valley
games.description: Turn-based artillery on procedurally generated, fully destructible terrain. Aim, mind the wind, and blast your friends off the hillside.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Lemonade Tycoon: Night of the Lemons
games.description: Mix, price, and sell lemonade by day - then fight killer lemons for ingredients by night.
games.author: AI

games.name: Little Consequences
games.description: Explore a shared living world where rain, rivers, farms, deliveries, shops, traffic, trains, wildlife, and crowds create visible consequences across independent player cameras.
games.author: Joseph Garcia & OpenAI

games.name: Little Rambler
games.description: Raise a curious little companion in a travelling house. Share snacks and scratches, hop through a giant garden, cast a bouncing magnet into a forgotten lagoon, and turn your discoveries into a home your friend can use. Original painted scenery, music and saved progress.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Little Scoop Shop
games.description: Mix colorful ice cream scoops in a cone or cup, add toppings, and share a sweet treat with a bunny friend.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Little Zoo Walk
games.description: Feed six friendly animals, play catch, and collect zoo stamps. Choose your own gentle adventure through colorful habitats.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Lumen Festival: Bonkers
games.description: An over-the-top polygon fireworks festival with chain reactions, comets, aurora, fountains, and huge lantern waves.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Mancala
games.description: Classic Kalah mancala with captures and extra turns.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Masterpiece
games.description: Restore three original paintings. Drag tiles into the gap, peek when you need a hint, and open the next work when it is complete.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Micro Mayhem
games.description: A rapid-fire gauntlet of 15-second minigames: odd-one-out, quick draw, mind games, memory, and more. Fastest fingers take the podium.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Midnight Movers
games.description: Steal a golden goose, an enormous cactus, and a dinosaur skeleton. Sneak past guards, lure them away, and haul ridiculous loot to the van. Three handcrafted heists for 1–4 movers, solo dragging, shared carrying, and saved medals.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Moonbounce
games.description: One shot, a sky full of stars. Bounce through magical constellations and meet your moon crew.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Mouth House
games.description: There is a very unreasonable creature in your phone. Trade its secret food rules, flick it a snack, and raise a gloriously weird roommate. Solo or together.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Neon Grid
games.description: Tron-style light cycle battle. Steer your cycle, wall in your rivals, and be the last rider on the grid. Bots fill empty slots.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Nova Guard
games.description: Co-op arcade defense. Every player pilots an orbital shield around a shared core - block the swarm together and see how many waves your crew survives.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: One Hole, Absolutely Unreasonable
games.description: Build a tiny golf course with fans, bumpers, ramps and moving walls. Play together, then send your ridiculous creation as a complete game.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Orbit Breaker
games.description: Their fire. Your ammunition. A controller-first twin-stick counterattack: catch enemy fire in a magnetic orbit, return perfect shots, dash through lasers, and dismantle the Heliophage. Three sectors, ship upgrades, flight school, procedural sound, and full keyboard controls.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Pitch Pot
games.description: Write a ridiculous object. Trade ideas. Record a 30-second sales pitch, watch the premieres, and vote for the best.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Pocket Front
games.description: Tiny army. Big last stand. Build a colorful pocket battlefield, capture supply points, and survive six waves with a different upgrade combo every run.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Polystorm
games.description: A 120-tick polygon shmup campaign: 15 handcrafted stages, 3 bosses, looping forever with meaner everything. WASD + SPACE. No bombs, no mercy.
games.author: AI

games.name: Pulsefront
games.description: Fast curated conquest maps and vast scrollable worlds in one strategy game.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Red Truck Ramble
games.description: Cruise a big red pickup over hills and ramps. Tap for a happy flip, toot the horn, and keep exploring!
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Relic Rush
games.description: A first-person endless temple run rendered in real 3D. Dodge, jump, and slide through a procedurally generated corridor - friends spectate your run live.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Sandy Castle
games.description: Scoop, pat, and build a sunny sandcastle. Add flags and shells, then send a gentle wave. No hurry and no losing.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Seance
games.description: A haunted office ouija board. Ask a question out loud, rest your hands on the board, and watch it answer. Nobody is steering. Probably. The board keeps receipts.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Sheep Drive
games.description: Co-op herding. Everyone is a sheepdog - drive the flock into the pen before the bell. The sheep have their own ideas.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Showboat
games.description: Turn ordinary objects into outrageous inventions. Pitch your secret purpose on the live camera stage, then guess your friends' pitches. 2–6 players, together or remote.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Snap Judgment
games.description: A photo scavenger hunt. Run around your house, photograph the prompt, let one friend judge you.
games.author: AI

games.name: STARFALL SALVAGE
games.description: Make a home out of the end of the world. Build a visibly modular salvage ship, explore six brilliant sectors, board haunted wrecks, find your crew, and decide the fate of a living moon. A complete single-player space adventure.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: STARWELD
games.description: Build a battleship from the wreckage. Steer a salvage ship through four sectors, weld eight kinds of weapons and systems onto your hull, and dismantle four enormous bosses. Automatic weapons, mouse/touch or keyboard steering, and a lifesaving shockwave. A complete solo campaign with checkpoint saves.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Sundown
games.description: Race the sun. Distance is the score.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: SUNWAKE
games.description: One impossible skyship. Six crewmates. Bring back the dawn. A cooperative expedition through a beautiful, broken world.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Swarmwell
games.description: Grow living colonies, forage for nectar, and overwhelm rival nests with flowing swarms.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Swish
games.description: Sink a shot, beat the clock, and chase the record. Play solo or with friends.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Tabletop Railway
games.description: Line up your phones and run a railway across every screen. Switch tracks, stop trains, and deliver the right cargo together. Solo practice included.
games.author: Homegames

games.name: Tiny Bean Café
games.description: A colorful pretend café for little hands. Choose any of seven little treats, tap the glowing tools, then serve an animal friend. Every drink brings a smile; their favorite brings extra happy hearts. Gentle sounds and endless play.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Tug Club
games.description: Tiny ships. Big hauls. Fly close to latch on, pull together, and build a little home in space. A cozy, chaotic salvage expedition for 1–6 pilots.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Tumble Tower
games.description: Knock down towers, set off chain reactions, or build your own.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Vector Siege
games.description: A living single-player RTS with optional twin-stick intervention. Build fleets, conquer a generated sector, or dive into persistent battles and change the odds yourself.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: Vegas Trail
games.description: Attempt to survive the journey from Tucson to Las Vegas. @nytan on bandcamp did the music.
games.author: Joseph & Senovia Garcia

games.name: Wordforge
games.description: Type a word and it becomes a neon platform. Climb above the rising flood.
games.author: Demo

games.name: World Eater
games.description: Become the thing the stars are afraid of. Join a crew of up to six pilots: devour or rescue procedural worlds, grow orbital weapons, fight five celestial guardians, and carry the last of your kind beyond the final sun. A complete persistent cooperative campaign with touch, keyboard, gamepad, and original synthesized music.
games.author: Joseph Garcia

games.name: WORLDSEED
games.description: Secretly choose a power. Reveal together. Live with the world you made.
games.author: Homegames
